102: Provides Quality of Service for storage I/O traffic.
48002: This counter set represents the statistics for a VHD file at the balancer level.
48006: This counter represents the average normalized IOPS of this client. This counter is updated every 4 seconds.
48010: Average scheduler queue length (issued and delayed I/O requests).
48014: Average device queue length (issued I/O requests only).
48018: Normalized maximum IO rate assigned to the flow.
48022: Normalized minimum IO rate assigned to the flow.
48030: Average number of quota replenishment operations per second.
48034: Average bandwidth of this client, in kilobytes per second.
48038: Maximum bandwidth assigned to this client, in kilobytes per second.
48202: This counter set represents the statistics for a storage device.
48206: Estimated average cost of an I/O request.
48210: Estimated average cost of an 8KB I/O request.
48214: Estimated overhead cost per I/O request.
48218: Estimated seek cost per I/O request.
48222: Estimated data transfer cost per I/O request per sector.
48230: Current amount of issued I/O in cost units (nanoseconds).
48234: Current amount of delayed I/O in cost units (nanoseconds).
48238: Current minimum issued cost threshold in cost units (nanoseconds).
48242: Current lower bound for the amount of issued I/O in cost units (nanoseconds).
48246: Estimated capacity of the underlying storage device in normalized IOPS.
48270: Average device queue length (issued I/O requests only).
48274: Average scheduler queue length (issued and delayed I/O requests).
